feeds.title: Digital Scrapper Blog
feeds.description: Digital Scrapper/Scrapper's Guide was started in September of 2003 by Linda Sattgast. In 2011, Scrapper's Guide was officially renamed Digital Scrapper and began offering training for digital scrapbooking in a series of online classes. In addition to scrapbooking classes Digital Scrapper also offers a variety of classes that teach basic to advanced photo editing techniques.

feeds.title: Pixel Scrapper Digital Scrapbooking Blog
feeds.description: Excellent digital scrapbooking community with free resources and products in an easy to find format.

feeds.title: Sweet Shoppe Designs Blog
feeds.description: Sweet Shoppe Designs is one of the finest digital scrapbooking suppliers on the web. Make your memories sweeter with digital scrapbook ideas from the sweetest spot on the web!

feeds.title: Kate Hadfield Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hand-drawn Digital Scrapbooking Kits and Clip Art for teachers, cardmakers and crafters! Digital scrapbook kits, freebies, tutorials, templates and more!

feeds.title: Pickleberrypop Blog
feeds.description: PBP is a friendly digital scrapbooking site welcoming all styles of scrappers from around the world! Come and join us for a little bit of scrapping and a whole lot of fun!

feeds.title: DigitalScrapbook.com Blog
feeds.description: Your source for digital scrapbooking and hybrid crafting, featuring travelers notebook, scrapbooking inspiration & advice, junk journal, and digital collage. Authored by Marisa Lerin.

feeds.title: Sahlin Studio Blog
feeds.description: An eclectic mix of classic and vintage digital scrapbook designs. Providing high quality unique digital scrapbooking supplies for you to document and preserve your memories. Find digital scrapbooking inspiration, products, freebies, tutorials and much more!

feeds.title: Moore Blessings Digital Design
feeds.description: Moore Blessings is a Digital Scrapbook Design and Digital Scrapbook Instruction Company. Find inspiration and ideas that will help you preserve your memories.

feeds.title: Changing Vases
feeds.description: A variety of digital scrapbooking supplies, digital paper packs, clip art, printable art, free digital scrapbook kit downloads, commercial clip art.

feeds.title: Digital Scrapbooking
feeds.description: Learn how to make your scrapbook layouts look very realistic and cherish your memories in photos through this awesome way.

feeds.title: The Digital Press Blog
feeds.description: Digital Scrapbooking is a versatile medium for preserving your life's memories. At The Digital Press, you will find a wide range of products that appeal to everyone from traditional scrappers, to pocket scrapbookers, to hybrid crafters, to those who love art journaling, and more! Enjoy your look around our site, and have fun preserving your memories ...because everyone has a story.

feeds.title: Digital Scrapbooking HQ Blog
feeds.description: At Digital Scrapbooking HQ, I would love to introduce you to the joy of scrapbooking with your computer. Here you'll find video tutorials that will help you learn about digital scrapbooking. You will be able to record your photos, stories, and memories in gorgeous digital and printed layouts that convey your unique style and perspective.

feeds.title: Designer Digitals Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the site with everything you need for all your digital scrapbooking ideas, art and photography projects. Designer Digitals is your source for digital scrapbooking tips and tutorials. Let us help you turn your photos into lasting memories.

feeds.title: Sahin Designs Blog
feeds.description: I am Elif, the designer behind Şahin Designs. My team and I are dedicated to guide and inspire memory keepers like you. So, if you want to learn new skills and get inspired, check out my blog where you can find new scrapbooking articles almost every week.

feeds.title: Megan M Scott
feeds.description: My name is Megan Scott and over the years I have gone through many evolutions as I have grown in my creative side. I am a SAHM currently and hope to return back to school to learn new skills in helping in Family History and Photo Restoration.

feeds.title: Rush Ranch Blog
feeds.description: My purpose with this blog is to be kind to share. I have loved computer graphics for many years as a hobby starting with Corel Draw, and finally advancing into the early versions of Photoshop.
